name: OPA1652 / OPA1654
type: FET-input audio op-amp, 2/4 channels, SMD only
tagline: Cheap TI SoundPlus FET dual/quad (4.5 nV/√Hz, 0.00005% THD+N, RRO); an OPA2134-class workhorse in portable DAPs.

lineage.note: SoundPlus line; original SBOS477 (2011-12) has 'Burr-Brown Audio' header. Sole source; all orderables Active (2026-07-15 addendum).
OPA1655/OPA1656 (SBOS901, 2019) reuse the OPA165x name but are a different, faster, lower-noise device.

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8 (D), tube of 75. Marking OP1652. Mouser lists it.
VSSOP/MSOP-8 (DGK), tube of 80. Marking OUPI. Lead finish NIPDAUAG.
VSSOP-8 (DGK), reel of 2500. Marking OUPI. Finishes NIPDAU | SN | NIPDAUAG (2026).
WSON-8 (DRG) with thermal pad, reel 3000/250. Marking OP1652. Added in SBOS477B (2016-12).
SOIC-14 (D), tube of 50 or reel of 2500. Marking OPA1654.
TSSOP-14 (PW), tube of 90 or reel of 2000. Marking OPA1654.

part_numbers.pn: OPA1652 'DIP' modules (e.g. Kyoritsu Q5M411 'OPA1652AID-DIP'; AliExpress 'AkLIAM OPA1612 OPA1652 OPA1656' adapters)
part_numbers.note: Third-party SOIC-on-DIP-8 adapters, not TI parts. TI never offered PDIP (TI E2E).

key_specs.value: 4.5 nV/√Hz (3.8 at 10 kHz; 4.0 µVpp 20 Hz–20 kHz)
2 mA typ, 2.5 mA max per channel (2.8 mA max hot)
±30 mA (ISC ±50 mA); swing within 800 mV of rails
±0.5 mV typ, ±1.5 mV max; drift 2 typ, 8 max µV/°C
±10 pA typ, ±100 pA max (also offset current)
FET (JFET or CMOS unconfirmed), folded cascode; class-AB RRO
key_specs.condition: phase-reversal protected; CM to V+ −2 V

reputation.summary: A workhorse, not a cult part: makers and a zigsow review call it the cheap SMD OPA2134 successor; TI says swappable in SO-8. Head-Fi posters call it very good for under $2 and close to OPA1656. Soomal teardowns show it in FiiO X5K, VentureCraft Vantam, Cayin N5 MKII; also HiBy R6 PRO II/III, R4, Cayin BTC-2. No bench measurements found.
typical_uses: DAC I/V conversion in portable players
Post-DAC low-pass filter and line-out stages
Headphone amp front end before discrete output stages
SO-8 OPA2134 replacement with light capacitive load
caveats: SMD only, no PDIP: rolling needs a DIP adapter, which adds capacitance.
Weak cap-load drive: 100 pF (datasheet), ~230 pF at G=−1 (TI E2E) vs 1 nF for OPA2134; add ~50 Ω.
±30 mA output (ISC ±50 mA): not a stand-alone low-impedance headphone driver.
Not rail-to-rail input: common-mode range ends 2 V below V+.
Noisier and slower than OPA1656 (4.5 vs 2.9 nV/√Hz; 18 vs 53 MHz; 10 vs 24 V/µs).

counterfeit_notes: No OPA1652 fakes reported, but fake OPA1612 (TL082 die) and OPA1656 exist. TI never made a DIP OPA1652. Genuine marks: OP1652 (D/DRG), OUPI (DGK), OPA1654. Check ~2 mA/channel Iq, pA-range bias, ~18 MHz GBW; buy authorised.

Unknown; no web copy. A move to TI's newer format (ESD, Recommended Operating Conditions sections) is a guess.
Added WSON-8 (DRG) package, pinout and thermal data (RθJA 66.9 °C/W). No electrical changes listed. Still latest as of 2026-09.
Not a revision: new package addendum, all orderables Active, new '.A'/'.B' sub-rows, multiple OPA1652AIDGKR lead finishes.

claims_confirmed: Current datasheet is SBOS477B, 'DECEMBER 2011 – REVISED DECEMBER 2016'; no later revision (https://pdf4pro.com/amp/view/sbos477b-december-2011-revised-december-253411.html, https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1652).

Original SBOS477 (December 2011, Burr-Brown Audio header) survives on mirrors (https://www.kyohritsu.com/eclib/OTHER/DATASHEET/TI/opa165254.pdf, https://datasheet.octopart.com/OPA1654AIPW-Texas-Instruments-datasheet-17727667.pdf).
TI product pages exist for OPA1652 and OPA1654 (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1652, https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1654).
TI calls it a 'Dual SoundPlus ... FET-input audio op amp': 18 MHz, 2 mA Iq, 4.5 nV/√Hz (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1652).
0.00005% THD+N; ±2.25 to ±18 V; 2 mA/channel; 800 mV swing; ±30 mA; 10 pA; 10 V/µs (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1652, https://datasheetspdf.com/pdf/1405490/etcTI/OPA1652/1).

TI E2E: similar specs to OPA2134, swappable in SO-8, no PDIP, ~230 pF vs 1 nF at G=−1 (https://e2e.ti.com/support/amplifiers-group/amplifiers/f/amplifiers-forum/600965/opa1652-replacing-opa2134-with-opa1652).
Mouser lists OPA1652AIDGKR, OPA1652AID and OPA1654AIPW (https://www.mouser.com/ProductDetail/Texas-Instruments/OPA1652AIDGKR?qs=3jfYfyvUSwBBvQAEBFbpyQ%3D%3D).
Head-Fi posters praise its sound for the price, compare it to OPA1656 and LME49720 (https://www.head-fi.org/threads/the-opamp-thread.432749/page-313).
